title: HHHusher hero
description: A full-window dark opener: a video fills the window and drifts down at half the scroll speed as you leave; a two-line medium-weight headline sits low in the middle and a short paragraph with a play square, a glass button and a yellow buy button sits low on the right. Headline and column rise in on load.
notes: always dark (wraps itself in .dark); pairs with hhhusher-header
media fills the window (cover); empty, it shows a quiet placeholder
drift is CSS scroll-driven; static elsewhere and under reduced motion
name: hhhusher-hero

props.description: the short paragraph in the right-hand column

props.description: screen-reader name of the play square; leave out to hide it
